title: XFX SPEEDSTER MERC 310 RX 7900 XTX GPU & AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU Bundle $1679 C&C/ in-Store Only @ Centre Com
body:
Deal: XFX SPEEDSTER MERC 310 RX 7900 XTX GPU & AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU Bundle $1679 C&C/ in-Store Only @ Centre Com

[monkeyjaja] They just updated FSR4 for Radeon 7000 series so at least the GPU is now ‘up-to-date’ even though it’s 1 gen behind.
[incipient] It takes a slight hit compared to the 9000 series when doing FSR4 - which makes it perform a bit worse than the 9070xt I think. Unless you needed the vram (ML use basically) you'd probably be better off with the 9070x (we've had them at $900 I think?)
[FujinShu] VRAM is still great to have for VR tho imo
[Jazza2400] Using a 7800xt, would it be a 50% increase because of 16 to 24gb?
[goodwillN1] @Jazza2400: Of VRAM? Yes 😁
Of performance? Mostly no
[nikoris] Not a deal, you can buy a 9070xt and a 9800x3d for cheaper. Which makes this overpriced.
Even if you prefer a 7900xtx to a 9070xt (which you shouldn't), it should be at the same price as a 9070xt not more expensive.
[kenmizuki] 9070xt and 9800x3d should be around 1400
[JoeOz] Only reason might be VRAM, still overpriced
[nov1911] and if you need more ram you'd almost certainly be better off with nvidia (unfortunately) for that work load
[Meteor Anarcom] Bundle deal ❌
Trying selling 2 clearance items at once on their normal price ⭕
[tanksinatra] Bad deal. You'll be better off with a 9700xt than that 2022 dinosaur.
The 9700xt has similar performance for way less money, less power consumption and has better RT
[jc209964] Where does one obtain possession of said 9700xt?
[tanksinatra] Same place. You can get the sapphire 9700xt for $889
https://www.centrecom.com.au/sapphire-pulse-rx9070-xt-16gb-o…
[perfectlydark] i paid $1000 more than that for my 7900 XTX 2.5 years ago, this is genuinely good info as I hadnt been keeping up with latest news. almost takes the sting out of the RAM changes
[krisspy] Imagine they send you a hairdryer and hair straightener instead
[CloudStrife7] Imagine if it was a towel and a scrunchie, that is the ultimate insult.
[conza] So the question really is, is the 7900XTX worth $132 more than a 9070XT, and for some people it might be, but even as a 7900XTX owner, even though they have access to FSR 4/4.1 now, I'm not sure that its worth that for gamers. Oh yeah, and there's the whole matter of, do you need/want to buy a CPU too? because its only $132 more if the 9070XT is $899 (everywhere all the time) and the 7900XTX from this deal, most favourably viewed as, $1031 (there's the $132).
It has a ~5-7% performance jump and this is basically 15% more expensive, so, that kinda tells you its a worse deal right?
The only niche is, you want to run local models between 16-23GB on your GPU, so, if you're considering doing that and don't have other hardware etc, then it's not a bad deal in that scenario, especially if you also plan to game on it, it's hard to say it's a down grade from a 9070XT, its only just a bit better, and a bit worse value.
[theone4u] This deal has been around for a while and pretty sure it has been cheaper before
